beats.text: Companies blamed AI for over a hundred and twenty thousand US job cuts this year. Then they suddenly stopped.
beats.dir: gripping mystery hook; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: That number comes from Challenger, Gray and Christmas, which tracks layoff announcements across America.
From March to July, AI was the number one reason companies gave.
By August, it had dropped to fourth.
Now the top reason is market and economic conditions.
So did AI stop replacing jobs? Not exactly.
beats.dir: curious, knowing; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: Saying AI sounds like progress. Saying the economy sounds like trouble. And which story companies tell can change with the headlines.
beats.dir: thoughtful, slightly wry; clear pause between sentences

beats.text: So when you read a layoff headline, check the reason — and who's really saying it.
beats.dir: confident payoff; clear pause between sentences
